selection.criterion: highest best validation mAP50-95 across the two arms; real-only tie break

protocol_description: Two YOLO11n models start from the same official COCO-pretrained weights: real-only and real plus 128 MaskGen-background composites. Each uses seed 42, 320 px inputs, batch 8, AdamW (lr0=0.001), 20 maximum epochs, 8-epoch patience and the first 10 modules frozen. Horizontal/vertical flips are disabled. Validation fitness selects the checkpoint; the 96-image test is evaluated after training. AP uses confidence threshold 0.001 and NMS IoU 0.7; the deployed display threshold is 0.25 and NMS IoU is 0.45 differ intentionally.
notes: Dominant target-sign boxes; not exhaustive dense street-scene annotation.
Codex visual overlay review; no independent human annotation audit.
Same 96 original test images for all conditions; inherited source dependence remains.
Synthetic composite boxes are exact visible alpha bounds; real boxes have annotation uncertainty.
Detector comparison tests the entire augmentation pipeline: 128 extra images, copy-paste, and extra optimizer steps are confounded with generated backgrounds.
Detector mAP and classifier accuracy measure different tasks.
One detector training seed per arm; no estimate of detector seed variation.
